extDescription.message: Detects the multiple-choice question in the tab you turn on and asks an AI (local with Ollama, or Claude) for a hint.

serverHelp.message: Run the install script again, or see “Manage the server” in the README.

injectionFailed.message: Could not start on this page: $1

helpModeLocal.message: Qwen, locally only. Free, nothing leaves your computer.

helpModeAuto.message: Qwen first; Claude takes over if Qwen is too slow, fails or is stopped.

helpModeClaude.message: Claude directly. Faster, but the question is sent to Anthropic.

helpModelHaiku.message: Haiku: the fastest and lightest. Hints are sometimes less subtle.

helpModelSonnet.message: Sonnet: fast and more than enough for quizzes.

helpModelOpus.message: Opus: the most capable, slower and uses more quota.

subscriptionConnected.message: Via Claude Code, included in your subscription (no per-token cost, but counts toward your limits). $1 call(s).

subscriptionNotInstalled.message: Claude Code is not installed: you need it to use your subscription.

subscriptionNotConnected.message: Claude Code is not signed in to your subscription: run “claude auth login” in a terminal.

createKeyAfter.message: . It is stored in the system keychain, not in the extension.

connectForOnline.message: Connect Claude to use the online engine.

autoWithoutClaude.message: Without Claude, the auto engine stays local.

captureOn.message: Unreadable images on screen are captured automatically.

captureOff.message: Otherwise: right-click the image › “Streamlet: read this image”. Turning this on asks for access to all sites.

resultsOnPage.message: Results are shown on the page, bottom right.

reminderActive.message: Remember to turn Streamlet off when your quiz is done. While it is on, every new page in this tab is sent to the AI: with Claude, that uses your subscription quota or API credits (tokens). For safety, it turns itself off after 2 minutes without a question.

autoStopped.message: Streamlet turned itself off: no quiz question for 2 minutes. Turn it back on from the extension icon if you need it.

helpReasoningFast.message: The answer only, in a few seconds, without thinking it through: no hint (they are unreliable without reasoning). Less reliable on tricky or multi-step questions.

helpReasoningNormal.message: Qwen reasons for up to 20 seconds, then gives a hint and the answer: slower, but safer.

fastNoHint.message: Fast mode: no hint, just the answer. Turn on “Show the answer”, or switch reasoning to Normal to get a hint.
